{{Quote|Soon we will merge, our bodies and our empires both.|[[Gar-Oth]]|<ref name="Starcrash">[[Star Wars (1998) 27|''Star Wars'' (1998) 27]]</ref>}}
'''Gar-Oth's Empire''' was a region controlled by the [[Yahk-Tosh]] warlord [[Gar-Oth]].<ref name="Starcrash" /> Gar-Oth had been prospecting for an easy world to conquer and add to his empire and in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he selected a small [[Lourdes' homeworld|planetoid]] ruled by an monarchy of [[elfish humanoid]]s. Gar-Oth invaded the world, [[Death/Legends|murdering]] its [[Lourdes' father|king]], and in order to gain legitimacy in the eyes of the world's residents, tried to force the king's daughter [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Lourdes]] to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] him.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|128|LOU 1-2|Princess Lourdes}}</ref> His plan was thwarted, however, by the princess and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]], leading to his death.<ref name="Starcrash" />
